# Stav Gueta (סתיו גואטה), event design in Ashkelon, Israel

> Event design in Ashkelon: custom photo walls, hafrashat challah evenings, helium balloons, fresh flowers and bridal cars. Planned with you, set up on site.

Tagline: "כשעיצוב יוצר רגעים שנשארים" (When design creates moments that stay). Area: Ashkelon and nearby. Also designed an event in Montenegro.

## Services
- Photo walls (עמדות צילום): Custom-designed backdrops with names, a date and a look that fits the event.
- Balloons (בלונים): Arches, walls and helium bouquets. Yes, balloons alone can turn a restaurant into a party.
- Flowers (פרחים): Fresh flowers for tables and displays, birthday bouquets and bridal bouquets.
- Hafrashat challah (הפרשת חלה): Full design for the evening: fabric, candles, flowers and table settings.
- Bridal car (רכב חתן כלה): Gypsophila, tulle and pearls for the couple’s car, with lettering on the rear window.
- Bachelorette (מסיבת רווקות): A wall in the bride’s style: bows, boho chic, pink stripes or something completely new.
- Bar & bat mitzvah (בר ובת מצווה): Photo walls, balloons and a welcome table made to measure.
- Brit, britah & zeved habat (ברית, בריתה וזבד הבת): Ceremonies welcoming a newborn. Soft displays in dusty pink, pearl and stone, or light blue and white for a brit.
- Birthdays (יום הולדת): From a balloon arch to a full display with a “Happy Birthday” sign at the right age.
- Room surprises (סידור חדר): A surprise room at home or in a hotel: balloons, flowers and anything you want to add.
- Giant numbers (מעמדי ספרות): Decorated giant numbers for an age or a date, for a photo people remember.
- Tu B’Av & special dates (ט״ו באב ותאריכים מיוחדים): A proposal, an anniversary or Tu B’Av, the Israeli day of love. A small moment with a big design.

## Shop (sample prices in ILS, to be confirmed)
- Helium balloon bouquet: from 180 ILS. Two large bubble balloons and two hearts in the colours you choose, tied with ribbon and ready to hand over.
- Flower bouquet: from 220 ILS. Fresh flowers in the shades you pick, wrapped and ready to give.
- Surprise room set-up: from 650 ILS. Balloons on the ceiling, the bed and the floor, numbers for the age and flowers of your choice.
- Bridal car decoration: from 350 ILS. Gypsophila, white tulle and pearls for the handles and the bonnet.
- Personalised bubble balloon: from 90 ILS. A clear or coloured balloon with a name, an age or a short message in script lettering.
- Giant numbers: from 250 ILS. Decorated numbers for an age or a date, for the photo wall or the room.

## How it works
1. Tell me about your event: Date, venue, number of guests and the style you like. Feel free to send photos that inspire you.
2. I suggest a custom design: Colours, materials and a clear quote. We adjust until it feels exactly right.
3. On the day, I set everything up: I arrive before you, set up, arrange and check every detail, so you walk into a finished room.
